headline: Mistakes to avoid with a hot spot on your floor
articleBody: When you find a warm patch on your floor, it's easy to make a few common errors that can make the problem worse. First, don't ignore it. A hot spot nearly always signals a slab leak from a hot water pipe, which can lead to significant foundation damage, mold, and huge water bills if not addressed promptly. It's not going to just disappear on its own. Second, don't try to pinpoint the leak by blindly digging into your floor or foundation. This can be dangerous, potentially damaging other utilities or making the repair much more complex and costly. Slab leak detection requires specialized equipment that most homeowners don't have. Third, avoid delaying professional help. Every day a slab leak goes unrepaired, more water is wasted, and more damage can occur to your home's structure. Fourth, don't assume it's just a minor issue. Even a small leak can have major repercussions over time.
